title: Amateur HAM radio workshop
summary: The Mangalore Amateur Radio Club introduced students to amateur radio, with a live demonstration.
body: Members of the Mangalore Amateur Radio Club visited the Vidyalaya in December 2015 and introduced students to amateur radio. They brought equipment and ran a live demonstration, so students could see a working station rather than only hear about one.

image.alt: A radio transceiver and a camera on a table in a hall, with students seated on the floor.
